name: Access & Roles — approval frames
description: Contract-freeze UX artifacts for the per-organization Access & Roles admin console at /settings/access. An org owner/admin views who has direct access to the organization and what role each member holds (owner / admin / member / viewer — the real organization_memberships.role enum), changes a member's role (promote/demote), and removes a member's access. Authorization is Permit-backed: the UI never decides who may act; it renders what the Security service's Permit decisions allow, and every write reflects into Permit via the owning service. Membership is one row per organization_memberships; access derived from above (parent/root/reseller ReBAC) has no row and is hidden by omission. Invitations are a SEPARATE feature (design/frames/org-invitations-v2, the invite modal at this same route) — this console links to it and does NOT duplicate add/invite. Approving a flow approves its visual + interaction model AND the component/package build inventory before UI implementation. frontend-test-engineer drives Playwright against these via the data-frame / data-* hooks.
reconciles: design/frames/org-invitations-v2 — owns invite/add at /settings/access (invite modal + pending list + accept). This console links to it; it never re-implements invite/add. Removing the former add-member frame here resolves the duplication.
design/frames/member-directory — the root/portal org ('members = everyone') uses the paginated directory, not this small-team list.
design/frames/employee-console — inherited/derived platform-staff (Employee) access is surfaced there, in a separate labelled panel, never in this direct-member list.
#529 root GUEST state — retired: signup writes organization_memberships(role='member') for root, so root resolves to user_role='member' (Member badge).

Role model: the fixed organization_memberships.role enum owner|admin|member|viewer (as declared by org-invitations-v2), replacing the prior admin/editor/viewer per-tenant role catalogue — no GET /roles catalogue dependency.

commissionedByApproval: 409 LAST_ADMIN on demote (PUT .../members/{userId}/roles) and on remove (DELETE .../members/{userId}) — does not exist in the contract today; the change/delete would currently succeed and leave the org unadministrable.
409 LAST_OWNER on demote and on remove of the org's only owner — net-new; the same ownership invariant org-invitations-v2 commissions on ownership-affecting actions. An org is never left ownerless.

Permit reflection: PUT roles and DELETE member must, in the owning Security write, sync the corresponding Permit role grant (grant on promote, revoke on demote/remove). Real authz lives in Permit, never in the UI or the feature flag.

Authorization split: viewing the member list requires only membership; mutating (change-role / remove / invite) requires the Permit permission organization:manage-members (owner/admin). A non-privileged caller gets the read-only render (frame d) with the mutating affordances ABSENT, and an attempted write fails closed with 403 shown in place (frame e4).
Contract rule: the member list is DIRECT active memberships only — inherited/derived (parent/root/reseller ReBAC) access has NO membership row and is never listed here (satisfied by omission).
The root org's user_role='member' (via the fuzefront.identity.root-membership backend slice) retires the #529 per-org GUEST state for root; the non-member state remains for ordinary un-joined orgs.

frames.label: (a) Members & roles
frames.summary: Member list for one org: person, role pill (owner/admin/member/viewer from the fixed OrgRole enum), per-row change-role / remove for a privileged caller, cursor 'Load more', and an 'Invite a member' action that links OUT to the org-invitations feature.
frames.acceptanceNotes: Rows render from GET /members (MemberPage, cursor). Each member carries exactly one role from OrgRole; an unrecognised value renders a neutral pill with its raw key, never a blank cell. Self-row is tagged 'You'. The list is DIRECT active memberships only (data-rule='direct-only'): principals whose access comes from above (parent/root/reseller ReBAC) have no membership row and MUST NOT appear; platform staff (Employee) are never listed. 'Invite a member' (data-action='invite-member', data-links-to='org-invitations-v2') routes to the org-invitations feature — this console never re-implements invite/add. Per-row change-role/remove render only when the caller holds organization:manage-members (Permit); otherwise see frame (d). For the root/portal org this small-team list is superseded by member-directory. No vendor name in the DOM.

frames.label: (b) Change role
frames.summary: Ordinary promote/demote (b1), the last-admin refusal (b2): the org's only admin cannot be demoted, and the last-owner refusal (b3): the org's only owner cannot be demoted.
frames.acceptanceNotes: PUT /members/{userId}/roles (RoleAssignment → 200 Member), reflected into Permit in the owning write. b2 proposes a 409 LAST_ADMIN and b3 a 409 LAST_OWNER, each with a client pre-check that disables the offending options; the disabled control is an affordance, the server must refuse independently. A failed save re-fetches true current role (replace is non-atomic today). A 403 on save (caller lost the manage permission) is shown in place per frame e4, never a sign-in redirect.

frames.label: (c) Remove member
frames.summary: Confirm removal (c1), the last-admin refusal (c2), and the last-owner refusal (c3): the org's only admin and only owner cannot be removed.
frames.acceptanceNotes: DELETE /members/{userId} (idempotent → 204), revoking the member's Permit role grant for the org. c2 proposes a 409 LAST_ADMIN and c3 a 409 LAST_OWNER, each with a client pre-check disabling the button. 403 (no permission) is distinct — shown in place per frame e4, never a sign-in redirect; the 409s mean the caller is allowed but the action is refused to protect the org.

frames.label: (d) Read-only (non-admin)
frames.summary: A member/viewer who holds no manage permission can view the member list, but the Actions column and the per-row change-role / remove / invite affordances are ABSENT (not disabled).
frames.acceptanceNotes: Same read as frame (a): GET /members succeeds for any member. When the caller's Permit decision for organization:manage-members is denied, the Actions column, per-row buttons, and Invite action are NOT rendered (data-state='read-only'); a read-only info banner (data-rule='view-is-member-manage-is-admin') explains. Absence is deliberate — not a greyed-out disabled control — and is defense in depth with frame e4: the UI hides, the server still refuses an attempted write.

frames.label: (e) States
frames.summary: Loading skeleton, single-member org empty state, load error+retry, an unauthorized action denied in place (403 on an attempted write), the non-member state, and the reconciliation that root is now Member (never GUEST).
frames.acceptanceNotes: Loading = aria-busy skeleton for in-flight GET /members. Empty is a real state (a fresh org has one member, its owner); its CTA links OUT to org-invitations. Error shows data-action='retry'. e4: a 403 FORBIDDEN on an attempted write (data-state='action-denied') is an AUTHORIZATION denial rendered in place on the dialog — NEVER a redirect to sign-in (only a 401 re-authenticates) — the fail-closed path when the manage permission was revoked between render and click. e5: the non-member state (data-state='non-member', NOT_A_MEMBER, 403) is shown in place for an ordinary un-joined org, and carries the reconciliation (data-rule='root-is-member') that this state NO LONGER applies to the root FuzeFront org — root resolves to user_role='member' and shows a Member badge (#529 retired).
